subject: MHS Security and School Climate Review
overview: The committee reviewed an extensive consultant report on Medford High School’s safety and culture, focusing on discipline data, leadership transitions, and facility security. The body also finalized the superintendent evaluation process and approved several resolutions regarding job descriptions, composting, and student travel.

items.title: Student Advisory Council and Policy Review
items.summary: Members discussed policy JIB and the legal requirement to meet with a student advisory council, with district leadership noting that existing student councils already meet during the school day.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Subcommittee Reports
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payrolls, and minutes, as well as reports from the Rules and Policy and Evaluation subcommittees.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation Template and Process
items.summary: Approved the template, instructions, and timeline for the upcoming superintendent evaluation process.

items.title: Superintendent’s Updates and Calendar Adjustments
items.summary: The superintendent recognized staff for various appreciation days and announced that elementary schools will shift away from early release Wednesdays in the next school year.

items.title: District School Choice Status
items.summary: Approved remaining a 'no school choice' district for the 2023-2024 school year as required by state regulation.

items.title: Student Travel to Italy
items.summary: Approved a World Language department trip to Italy scheduled for Spring 2024.

items.title: MHS and MVTHS Safety, Security, and Climate Review
items.summary: Administrative consultant Michael Welch presented findings from a 33-day study on high school culture, recommending unified scheduling, an associate principal role, and pursuing MSBA grants. The committee passed motions to clarify the high school dress code specifically regarding backpacks, hats, and hoods to address implementation inconsistencies.

items.title: Job Description Review Cycle Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a timeline for the comprehensive review of all district job descriptions by September 2024.

items.title: District-Wide Composting Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution seeking an update on the administration’s plans to implement district-wide composting for the 2023-2024 school year.

items.title: Website Transparency and Accessibility
items.summary: Referred a resolution regarding website updates to promote family engagement and accessibility to the Communications and Family Engagement Subcommittee.
